conditions.text: C1 — The vendored Śekhara's no. 28 is कृद्ग्रहणे गतिकारकपूर्वस्यापि ग्रहणम् ("where a kṛt is named, the kṛdanta with a gati/kāraka before it is meant too") — which is what the engine's effect text describes. गतिकारकोपपदानां कृद्भिः सह समासवचनं प्राक् सुबुत्पत्तेः is no. 76, a different maxim (the label in the audit brief is off). It holds for a kṛt in general and for a particular kṛt.

quotes.quote: गतिकारकोपपदानां कृद्भिः सह समासवचनं प्राक् सुबुत्पत्तेः

conditions.text: C2 — Its jñāpaka is the word अनन्तरः in 6.2.49; there (and in 7.1.37) the commentators say it is NOT applied.

not_licensed.line: 6.2.49 where a kṛt suffix is named, the word with a gati or kāraka before it is meant too  ⟨where a kṛt suffix is named, the word with a gati or kāraka before it ⟩
not_licensed.why: The engine's own quotation is a denial: by the force of अनन्तर the maxim is not resorted to here; the Śekhara adds that in 6.2.49 the bare क्तान्त is taken. 6.2.49 is the jñāpaka site, not an application.

quotes.quote: <<गतिरनन्तरः>> [[6.2.49]] इत्यत्र तु गतेः पूर्वपदस्य क्तान्त उत्तरपदे परे कार्यविधानात्तत्समवधानेऽपि केवलस्य क्तान्तत्वेन ग्रहणं बोध्यम्

not_licensed.line: 7.1.37 where a kṛt suffix is named, the word with a gati or kāraka before it is meant too  ⟨where a kṛt suffix is named, the word with a gati or kāraka before it ⟩
not_licensed.why: Again a denial: the क्त्वान्त samāsa is reached by tadantavidhi (1.1.72), "not by" this maxim (with it a नञ्-compound could never arise, so अनञ्पूर्वे would be idle). 1.1.72 is already credited here (layer 1, Kāśikā).

quotes.quote: स च <<येन विधिस्तदन्तस्य>> [[१.१.७२]] इत्यनेन तदन्तविधिना, न तु <<कृद्ग्रहणे गतिकारकपूर्वस्यापि०>> इति।
कृद्ग्रहणे गतिकारकपूर्वस्यापि ग्रहणेन (व्या।प।126) वा प्रत्ययग्रहणपरिभाषया (भो।प।सू।7) तदन्तग्रहणं न शक्यते वक्तुम्।

missed.why: स्वयं क्तेन: Nyāsa applies the maxim so that a gati-preceded क्तान्त (स्वयंविलीनम्) compounds with स्वयम्; no credit. Rare otherwise (the engine's 4 credits are the only ones).
